### Checklist for Auto-Merge:

- [ ] I have **ONLY** touched my own folder (`students/<NAME>-<ID>-<YourGithubUsername>/`) and optionally `students.json`.
- [ ] I have **NOT** modified `.github/` workflows/scripts, root `index.html`, `sessions/`, or `README.md`.
- [ ] My PR branch name matches the format: `add-<NAME>-<ID>-<YourGithubUsername>` (NOT `main`).
- [ ] My PR title matches the format: `add: <NAME>-<ID>-<YourGithubUsername>`.
- [ ] "Allow edits from maintainers" is enabled (checked by default).
